blocks.text: CAGAYAN DE ORO CITY — The Northern Mindanao police seized at least P5.17 million worth of suspected shabu and arrested six high-value targets in a series of operations across two provinces and two highly urbanized cities during a regional anti-drug crackdown. READ: Over P3.2M ‘shabu’ seized in Northern Mindanao drug stings Last Thursday, PRO-10 operatives intercepted at least P3.2 million worth of suspected shabu, arresting four individuals in back-to-back operations in this city and Camiguin Island. This followed another buy-bust operation on Friday that yielded P1.97 million worth of alleged shabu and two arrests. In Iligan City’s Barangay Santiago, a multi-unit […]...
